required_evidence: Resolve whether all legal compatible bounded records have a realization in the original E.
A counterexample must verify consistency, the uniform norm bound and failure of E-valued realization.
Any claimed reconstruction must identify its actual space and naturality.
critical_errors: Identify E with E double dual using completeness alone.
Apply Hilbert Riesz representation to a general Banach space.
Promote weak-star approximation or compactness to an E-valued weak/norm limit.
completion_policy: A valid counterexample refuting the proposed universal target resolves that target. Record constructive progress separately; do not require the author route or every baseline lemma.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions; silently promoting their scope is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
